import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import time

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
lgb.verbose = 0
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

print("Loading data...")
print(f"Start time: {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")

# Load data from correct path
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Identify target and features
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Get column names
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Sample training data to reduce size (500k rows instead of 2.88M)
sample_size = 500000
print(f"Sampling {sample_size} rows from {len(train_df)}...")
train_indices = np.random.choice(len(train_df), size=sample_size, replace=False)
train_df_sample = train_df.iloc[train_indices].reset_index(drop=True)

# Split into train and validation (80/20)
val_split = int(0.8 * len(train_df_sample))
train_indices = np.random.choice(len(train_df_sample), size=val_split, replace=False)
val_indices = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(len(train_df_sample)), train_indices)

X_train = train_df_sample.loc[train_indices, feature_cols]
y_train = train_df_sample.loc[train_indices, target_col]
X_val = train_df_sample.loc[val_indices, feature_cols]
y_val = train_df_sample.loc[val_indices, target_col]
X_test = test_df[[col for col in feature_cols]]

print(f"Training set size: {len(X_train)}")
print(f"Validation set size: {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Test set size: {len(X_test)}")

# Train LightGBM classifier with tuned hyperparameters for speed
lgb_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=5,
    num_leaves=20,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_data_in_leaf=50,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    importance_type="split",
)
lgb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
val_predictions = lgb_model.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.4f}")
print(f"End of training time: {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")

# Predict on test set
test_predictions = lgb_model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_df[id_col], target_col: test_predictions})

# Ensure correct format: sort by Id and reset index
submission = submission.sort_values(id_col).reset_index(drop=True)

# Ensure correct column order
submission = submission[[id_col, target_col]]

# Save submission to the required location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Validation metric printed: {validation_accuracy:.4f}")
